opinions.text: Motions of the State of Louisiana and the United States for entry of Supplemental Decree No. 2 are set down for oral argument during week of October 14, 1968. Main briefs of counsel shall be filed on or before August 15, 1968, and reply briefs on or before September 16, 1968.
